chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him, “From where does the cutting become obligatory?” So he spread out his fingers and said, “From here,” meaning from the joint of the palm.

key_terms.أَصَابِعَهُ: his fingers, which the Imam spread to indicate the place
key_terms.الْقَطْعُ: the prescribed cutting in the legal punishment

ai.seo_question: From where is the hand cut in the hadd punishment for theft according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal point at which the hand is to be cut in the hadd punishment for theft. The Imam عليه السلام clarifies it physically by indicating that the cutting is from the joint of the palm.
